label_gene_scope: Conservative known source/endpoint/transfer marker exclusion; not an exhaustive removal of annotation circularity
score: mean probability program genes outrank fixed reference genes within each cell; ties=0.5; remove module/reference overlap

reference_universe.selection: Feature identity intersection only; no expression values inspected for reference selection

custom_panel_note: Immediate_early_AP1_panel is an analyst-prespecified short marker panel, not a complete pathway or causal activity assay
